requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations and protect student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording with comprehensive logging of attendance changes.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated for administrators include anonymized data.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall ensure secure authentication of users and incorporate performance-efficient methods.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization while optimizing for energy efficiency.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall implement tiered storage solutions that align with compliance and ethical standards for historical data.
The system shall incorporate energy-efficient algorithms in real-time synchronization to lower energy consumption.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
